parsed.note_claim: The videos and incident are from the January 2, 2024 runway collision at Tokyo Haneda Airport.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: A Japan Airlines (JL/JAL) Airbus A350 has been involved in a serious accident at Tokyo Haneda Airport on the evening of Tuesday, January 02, 2024. The aircraft collided with a De Havilland Canada DHC-8-315Q operated by the Japan Coast Guard on the runway
parsed.reason: The page directly describes the January 2, 2024 runway collision at Tokyo Haneda Airport involving a Japan Airlines A350, confirming the note's central claim.
